question: Why do stacked linear layers without activations not increase expressiveness much?
direct_answer: Their composition is still just a single linear transformation.
expanded_answer: If each layer only applies a linear map, then multiplying those maps together gives another linear map. The model may have many parameters, but the overall input-output relationship remains linear, so the depth does not create new kinds of functions.
key_points: Composition of linear maps is linear
Many parameters do not imply nonlinear behavior
common_wrong_ideas: More layers always mean more complexity
Linear composition becomes nonlinear by stacking
